name: Japanese Chicken Curry
subtitle: Chicken, potato, carrot and peas in curry-roux sauce, over rice
equipment: Instant Pot, rice cooker or pot

macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: Roux blocks differ by brand. Check the box for how much water goes with the amount you use, and use ½ cup less than it says, since the Instant Pot loses almost none.
notes: Japanese home-style curry (kare) built on store roux blocks, which is how it's made in most Japanese homes. The roux never goes in under pressure: it scorches and triggers a burn notice. Onions cooked to golden give the sauce its sweetness. Peas aren't in every version; they're here as the green vegetable.

items: ½ box (3½–4 oz) Japanese curry roux blocks

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Rinse **2 cups rice** until the water runs mostly clear. Cook with **2½ cups water** in the rice cooker, or in a covered pot: boil, then lowest heat **15 min**, then rest **10 min** off heat.

steps.title: Prep everything
steps.body: Slice **2 onions** into thin half-moons. Cut **1 lb carrots** into 1-inch chunks. Halve **1½ lb baby potatoes**. Grate **3 cloves garlic + 1 tsp ginger** into a small bowl. Cut **2½ lb chicken** into 1½-inch chunks and toss with **1 tsp kosher salt**. Measure **3 cups water**. Break **½ box roux** into its cubes.

steps.title: Brown the onions
steps.body: Instant Pot on Sauté High. Add **1 Tbsp neutral oil**, then the onions and a pinch of salt. Cook **8 min**, stirring now and then, until soft and golden at the edges.

steps.title: Fill the pot
steps.body: Add the **garlic and ginger** and stir 30 seconds. Pour in the **3 cups water** and scrape the bottom completely clean. Add the **carrots, potatoes and chicken**. Don't add the roux yet.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.body: Cancel Sauté. Lid on, valve sealed. High pressure **5 min**, then let it release naturally **5 min**, then vent. It takes about 10 min to come up to pressure.

steps.title: Thicken with the roux
steps.body: Open the lid with the pot off. Stir in the **roux cubes** until they dissolve. Switch to Sauté Normal and simmer **4–5 min**, stirring along the bottom, until the sauce coats a spoon. Stir in **1 Tbsp ketchup + 1 Tbsp Worcestershire + 1 tsp honey + 2 cups frozen peas** and cook **2 min** more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Curry over rice. If it's too thick, loosen with a splash of water; too thin, simmer a couple of minutes longer.

after: Pack 3 lunches: curry over rice. It thickens in the fridge, so add a splash of water before reheating.
